instantiate_only_when: A specific intervention has documented competent institutional approval, accountable owner, IMPLEMENTATION_READY evidence, financial-validation history for savings claims, permitted records and accepted operational guardrails.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Approve a scoped intervention charter, competent authority, accountable owner, guardrails and stop authority.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Predeclare service, finance, safety, quality, readiness and uncertainty measures with data handling.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Freeze authenticated feasible baseline including existing reforms and signed comparator/attribution rules.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Execute only the approved change in the permitted environment; preserve change log and rollback path.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Observe complete financial and operational outcomes over the predeclared window, including adverse results.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Reconcile provider, retained and downstream work, internal charge elimination and all transition/residual liabilities.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Independently assess attribution, net financial effect and operational safeguards; recognize only eligible disjoint effects.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

conditional_eight_step_template.required_work: Competent owner decides scale, revise, retain current arrangement or rollback based on observed evidence.
conditional_eight_step_template.next_gate: Previous step independently accepted and competent owner confirms this step may proceed.

stop_rule: Stop or roll back under the named competent owner if predeclared safety, mandate, readiness or service thresholds fail; do not invent numeric thresholds without approved baselines.
completion_boundary: Repository planning can complete; live implementation and realized-benefit assurance remain blocked until actual approvals and observations exist.
